name: UniSDF-based Latent NeRF
definition: A geometry estimator and appearance model using UniSDF, a state-of-the-art volume rendering approach based on a signed distance function (SDF), which decouples geometry from appearance and allows mesh extraction for radiance cue computation.
summary: UniSDF-based Latent NeRF decouples geometry and appearance by extracting a mesh from a signed distance function to compute radiance cues, enabling relightable 3D assets with specular highlights.
